reply_text:
Nadia, I've posted the Vantorre Group ticket list in #strategic-pod as a reply to your message. It has four tickets, each with its source:

1. **#8841** (also written PD-8841): the Allentown gate kiosk / check-in issue. It appears in #strategic-pod (Gideon, 1 Jul, says it was closed), the 27 Apr, 4 May and 30 Sep team-strategic digests. The September digest describes it as a new Newark issue, so it may have been reopened or the number reused. Please check.
2. **INC-4821**: the Hartford gate kiosk outage from 3 Aug. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon at 11:08 on 3 Aug.
3. **VT-55120**: the root-cause ticket for the Hartford outage. Source: #inc-vtg-hartford, Gideon, 14 Oct.
4. **PD-4418**: a Carrier_Dwell_Summary export issue. Source: the 15 Sep team-strategic digest. That digest doesn't name the account, so I couldn't confirm it is Vantorre Group.

The 3 Aug digest has no ticket numbers, and the other 2025 digests don't either. I only used the three sources you named, plus the team-strategic digests, which are public to your team.
